title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each data point as its own cluster and iteratively merges the closest clusters until all points are in a single cluster.

title: What is Average Linkage?
text: Average linkage calculates the average distance between all pairs of points in two clusters. This average distance is used to determine which clusters to merge.

title: Counting Iterations
text: In agglomerative clustering, the number of iterations needed to merge all points into one cluster is equal to the number of points minus one.

title: Calculate the Number of Iterations
text: Given that there are $$6$$ pandas, calculate the number of iterations needed to merge them all into one cluster using the formula: number of points minus one.
